# Cooki UI — Full Developer & AI Agent Specification

Generated: 2026-10-04T11:16:28.360Z
Components in Registry: 70

## Architecture Overview
Cooki UI is designed as a source-first, registry-driven component platform. Each component lives in `registry/[category]/[slug]/` with its exact implementation, isolated demo, and shadcn-compatible `metadata.json`.

---

## Component Registry Directory

### Audio Waveform Visualizer (`audio-waveform-visualizer`)
- **Category**: 3d
- **Description**: Kinetic frequency equalizer with spring bouncing bars, soundwave playback toggles, and BPM tracking.
- **Tags**: N/A
- **Dependencies**: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react
- **Registry Endpoint**: `https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/audio-waveform-visualizer.json`
- **CLI Command**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/audio-waveform-visualizer.json`

#### Installation & Usage
```tsx
import { AudioWaveformVisualizer } from "@/components/ui/audio-waveform-visualizer"

export default function Example() {
  return <AudioWaveformVisualizer />
}
```

- **Description**: Compact search capsule expanding smoothly into a multi-tag command prompt with shortcuts.
- **Tags**: N/A
- **Dependencies**: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react
- **Registry Endpoint**: `https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/expandable-search-bar.json`
- **CLI Command**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/expandable-search-bar.json`

#### Installation & Usage
```tsx
import { ExpandableSearchBar } from "@/components/ui/expandable-search-bar"

export default function Example() {
  return <ExpandableSearchBar />
}
```
